feeds.title: Money Magazine
feeds.description: Money magazine is Australia's longest-running and most-read personal finance magazine. Easy-to-understand financial news, advice, reviews, and awards. Since 1999, Money has been providing credible, independent, easy-to-understand financial advice to help its readers save money and make the most of their investments.

feeds.title: The Frugal Samurai
feeds.description: Hi there, thanks for stopping by! This site is predominantly about personal finance and development and is a way to share with you some of the experiences which I have and continue to encounter in my life. The aim is to post some light entertainment as well as comment on topical financial issues which I hope you find amusing, informative and time well spent.

feeds.title: Enough Wealth
feeds.description: A personal finance blogger writing since July 2006, that tracks the ups and downs of trying to accumulate a seven-figure net worth on a five-figure salary. Regular posts discuss actual saving, budgeting and investment decisions, track my net worth, and a bit about trying to loose weight, get fit, do post-grad courses and launch a financial planning business - all while working full-time.

feeds.title: Barefoot Investor
feeds.description: Covers articles on financial education, and answers to users' financial questions. The Barefoot Investor is Australia's most trusted independent finance expert. It broadcasts and publishes financial education via newsletters, emails, websites, television, radio, audio recordings, seminars, and written reports.

feeds.title: The Swoosh Money Blog
feeds.description: The Swoosh Money Blog is the best place to work out your money muscles. Read about money saving hacks, financial tips & how to achieve financial freedom.

feeds.title: Strategy First Blog
feeds.description: Unlock the secrets to financial success with our expert tips and insights. Information on Financial Planning, Superannuation, and more.

feeds.title: StudentSavings
feeds.description: How to save more money and make more money. Investing and personal finance advice.

feeds.title: Thrive Financial Services Blog
feeds.description: Thrive Financial is your Sunshine Coast Financial Advisor. In their blog, they share relevant financial news, market trends, and valuable tips to help you make informed decisions about your money and investments. Stay tuned for regular financial news advice, and move on your journey to financial freedom!

feeds.title: Edwardpress Finance
feeds.description: EdwardPress Finance is a comprehensive blog dedicated to exploring the dynamic world of finance, personal finance, and business topics. It serves as a go-to resource for individuals seeking to deepen their understanding and enhance their skills in financial management. Each post on the blog is crafted to provide valuable insights, practical advice, and up-to-date information tailored to a diverse audience, from financial novices to savvy investors.

feeds.title: Financial Autonomy Blog
feeds.description: The focus of Financial Autonomy is to help you gain a choice in life. That might be chosen as to how many hours a week you work when you retire, what you do to earn your income, or where you live. My focus is on providing helpful and actionable information and advice so you can set effective goals, optimize your cash flow, develop an investment strategy, and stretch your entrepreneurial wings.

feeds.title: Ozzie News » Finance
feeds.description: The Australian News is your news, entertainment, and lifestyle magazine. Since 2002, we provide you with the latest breaking news and stories by Australians, for Australians. Keep up with articles on finance from Ozzie News.

feeds.title: John Treadgold
feeds.description: John is a writer and researcher who specializes in impact investing and international relations. He has more than a decade of experience in economic analysis and content strategy.

feeds.title: The Spreadsheet Dad
feeds.description: Hi there, welcome to The Spreadsheet Dad blog! I am a thirty something year old Australian man who has a passion for personal finance and being the best father I can be to my two beautiful children and better husband to my wonderful wife.

feeds.title: Edwena Dixon
feeds.description: Edwena is the founder of Richer Every Day, a personal finance blog for high achievers. Edwena has developed these strategies over years of being the Director of Pinpoint Finance, a multi-award-winning mortgage brokerage in Australia.

feeds.title: The Flawed Consumer
feeds.description: The Flawed Consumer is a personal finance blog that follows a flawed Gen Y consumer in her quest to achieve wealth, simply by changing spending habits.

feeds.title: Aussie Finance Blog
feeds.description: The Aussie Finance Blog is a new personal blog about finance tips, insurance options, real estate, investments, career advices and similar topics.

feeds.title: MoneyBites
feeds.description: Money Bites is on a mission to make money education more accessible and deconstruct financial literacy. We do this through our blog, our comprehensive resource list.
